The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b0540eb39aad89c2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: The arithmetic representation ρ determines a continuous parameter σ1 : πet 1 ((U1)D) −→ PGLn(L′ ) for a finite coefficient extension L′/L, together with equivariance under φ, with the following properties. (i) Its geometric image is Zariski dense. After compatible choices of frames it is the same compact subgroup as ρ(πet 1 (U0,k)). (ii) Its boundary homomorphism is γ 7−→ exp(tℓ(γ)N1), (4.2) where N1 is regular nilpotent. Every prime factor of characteristic-zero inertia other than ℓ acts trivially. (iii) In compatible frames at the coordinate-neutralized root gerbes of x1, the equivariance has a single value A ∈ H0, where H0 = ρ(πet 1 (U0)), and Ad(A)N1 = qN1. (4.3) (iv) For every algebraic representation of PGLn, the associated local system over (U1)K admits an invariant lattice whose finite reductions extend lisse over UR, equivariantly under φ. Their specializations recover the tensor local system of ρ, including its given arithmetic action.
